dedupe_keys.name: african transport systems database afts db

description: The African Transport Systems Database (AfTS-Db) is presented by its authors as the first complete geolocated multi-modal transport database for the whole of Africa, covering road, rail, aviation, maritime and inland waterway networks. Asset and network data were created and standardised across modes, with inter-modal connections, attributes of road and rail corridors and estimated annual statistics for airports and ports. It holds 234 airports with their airline routes, 179 maritime ports and their connections, 132 inland ports and docking sites with river and lake connections, 4,412 railway stations on 99,373 km of rail lines, and 1,004,512 km of roads, mainly motorways, trunk, primary and secondary roads plus local roads that connect to other modes. Coverage is continental. The files are GeoPackage networks per mode (roads about 1.6 GB, railways, airports, maritime, inland waterways and a multimodal network), CSV corridor and rail cost tables and a metadata workbook, free on Zenodo under the CC BY 4.0 licence, in several versions from 2025. Caveats: airport and port statistics are estimates, and road coverage beyond the main classes is partial. The authors built it for transport planning, resilience assessment, asset management and transport models; it suits network flow, criticality, cascading failure and hazard exposure analysis across African corridors. It complements the African development corridors database and OurAirports.
